routes.name: Universal certification of the prescribed-probability order trial

C9000279.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 279 (Exact quantum factoring over a fixed finite gate set.; papers: Exact quantum factoring over a fixed finite gate set; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/279.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C_ORDER_TRIAL.statement: For every original admissible input, the fixed-gate trial returns only positive order multiples below B and has true-order probability phi(r)*2^(-ceil(log2(r))-10), without order advice or residue enumeration.

C_SELECTED_TRANSFORM.statement: The forward-shift circuit has unnormalized selected-branch matrix Q^(-1/2)*g(kx/Q), including the ancillary test probability.

C_BIN_RECOVERY.statement: Rounded reduced fraction bins with denominator below B are unique and recoverable in polynomial bit time.

C_DYADIC_MAJORANT.statement: P, the coefficient-rounded majorant U, and its exact nonenumerative sum S are polynomial-bit dyadics satisfying the bounds in lem:majorant.

C_POLYGON_CORE.statement: Every average of the quarter-linear phase interpolant over an interval of length at most one half has modulus at least one half; a three-sector polynomial certificate proves the bound.

C_SECTOR_BOUND.statement: Over the reals the three exact integrated polygon sectors have squared modulus at least one quarter of their squared interval length, under their respective segment-length constraints.

C_POWER_SUMS.statement: For every natural M, the five rational polynomials in exact_certificate.json are exactly the sums of u^q over 0 <= u < M, for q=0,1,2,3,4.

C_PROGRESSION_ARITHMETIC.statement: For every reduced rounded label and residue, P is computed by at most three affine progression sums, is a polynomial-bit dyadic, and differs from the integral squared modulus by at most 32/Q.

C_ENVELOPE_SUM.statement: The upward coefficient-rounded quartic envelope has at most eight pieces; consistent half-open integer ownership and five power sums compute its exact dyadic total without residue enumeration.

C_RESIDUE_MASS.statement: At d equal to the true order, the actual phase-register-success and rounded-bin probability equals the sum of P over residues, with no postselection normalization.

C_ORDER_RESOURCES.statement: Every arithmetic, modular-power, shift, label-recovery, and dyadic-retention operation has uniform polynomial bit and fixed-finite-gate complexity and polynomial workspace, with no order advice.

C_ORDER_CORRECTION.statement: The dyadic downward rounding and two correction modes use valid probabilities and produce exactly lambda(d) per reduced true-order numerator.

C_MAIN.statement: The manuscript's full fixed-finite-gate exact factoring theorem thm:main holds.

C_FACTOR_PROCESS.statement: Proposition prop:process supplies complete verifiable auxiliary data, computable transition probabilities, and all-good completion within polynomial caps.

C_DEFERRED_FILTERS.statement: Proposition prop:known-probability identifies deferred and analytical passing events and gives success mass (1-2^(-n))^(n^10).

C_PRIMALITY.statement: Lemma lem:primality gives an exact polynomial-time primality decision for every 2 <= m < B.

C_QUARTER_AMPLIFICATION.statement: Lemma lem:quarter and equation eq:one-reflection produce certain correct output using the stated fixed gates once prop:known-probability holds.
